description: Gets one OSNT.IN daily-brief item by its id, the 12 characters after /c/ in an app.osnt.in/c/ link: its title, date, every source it cites (name and link) and its page. No item text. An item removed in a correction says so. We attribute, we don't verify. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link (https://www.osnt.in or the item's own link).

id.description: The item id: the 12 characters after /c/ in an app.osnt.in/c/ link.

name: get_item
title: One OSNT.IN item
